summary: Without tools and with a knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04, the fiscal Q1 2026 results (period ending March 2026, reported April 2026) cannot be verified from pre-existing knowledge. Both the revenue amount and the record-high status are therefore insufficiently evidenced.
